name: Матовий майстер: лінійний мат
description:
The lawnmower mate is a mating method that every mate monster should master. In this lesson we use a queen and a rook for our lawnmower mate. As you will see in the next lesson, you can also use two rooks.

Study the examples to understand how the lawnmower mate works.

Example 1 shows how the king is mated in het end.
Example 2 explains how to get there step-by-step.

Make sure to replay this example a couple of times, until you feel confident that you can do it yourself.
The trick is to switch between queen and rook in every move. Fence off the king with one of the pieces. And force the king towards the edge by checking the king with the other piece.

It is as if the rook and queen are mowing the lawn: no blade of grass is left uncut. The lawn-mower mate is also known as ‘ladder mate’.

What do you have to do?

Deliver a lawnmower mate. Alternate between queen and rook and roll back the black king. Gradually cut off all escape paths.
Keep your pieces safe and well protected.
It may take 3 or 4 moves before you can checkmate the king, but that won’t be a problem once you have grasped this.

examples.text:
The queen fences off the king by controlling the 7th rank (see green arrow).
The rook attacks the king and takes away all escape squares on that rank (see green arrow).

Notice that the queen protects the rook.
White cannot get out of check by capturing the rook.

examples.text:
The queen cuts off the king’s escape paths on the 5th rank (green arrow). She is in a good spot.
Now, White is going to take away more escape squares. He brings in the rook to do that.

The rook moves up two rows and checks the king. The king is forced to step back.
Now the rook is positioned nicely, fending off the king on the 6th rank.

White gets his queen. She checks the king on the 7th rank (while still protecting the rook).
The king is forced backward again.
Now, the rook can finish the job. It moves to the 8th rank.

Do you recognise this position? It is the mating pattern from example 1. Checkmate!
